name: accession
label: PSI accession
description: PSI investigation identifier (cite with its DOI)

name: record_type
label: Record type
description: test (one run) | session (one day/condition) | test_matrix (planned ranges) | data_reference

name: source_file
label: Source file
description: PSI experimental-table file the record was parsed from

name: source_row
label: Source row
description: 1-based row number in the source CSV (header = row 1)

name: fuel
label: Fuel / sample
description: Fuel or sample as written in PSI

name: material_class
label: Material class
description: Normalised material family (e.g. PMMA, SIBAL fabric)

name: o2_mole_frac
label: O2 mole fraction
description: Initial ambient O2 (oxidizer-stream O2 for inverse flames — see quality flags)

name: pressure_kpa
label: Pressure
description: Ambient pressure converted to kPa (from mmHg, atm, bar or psia)

name: diluent
label: Diluent
description: Inert gases present besides N2 (CO2, He)

name: gravity
label: Gravity
description: microgravity for all PSI flight data

name: outcome
label: Outcome (as reported)
description: End state as written in PSI

name: quality
label: Quality flags
description: Every interpretation made while parsing (assumed_unit, typo_corrected...)

name: flame_extinction_diameter
label: Flame extinction diameter
description: FLEX: droplet diameter at visible flame extinction

name: burning_rate_constant
label: Burning-rate constant K
description: FLEX: d²-law burning rate (header unit 'mm' in PSI — verify)

name: 1g_burn_length
label: 1-g burn length
description: SAFFIRE-II: same sample type burned in normal gravity

name: o2_final_pct
label: Final O2
description: BASS-II chamber O2 after the test
